summary: listmonk is a self-hosted Go+PostgreSQL newsletter/mailing-list manager: admins create lists, import/segment subscribers, author campaign emails (templates, transactional messages), schedule and send campaigns through an in-process send loop, track opens/clicks, record and act on bounces, and manage users/roles/settings; public pages handle subscription/optin/unsubscribe/preferences and a public archive. All state (subscribers, lists, campaigns, bounces, media, templates, users, roles, sessions, settings, and materialized dashboard views) is persisted in PostgreSQL, written and read back by the CRUD API.
